shipped_rows.title_o: Exploring the Relationship Between Sports Fandom and the Black Criminal Stereotype

blind_target.evidence_quote: Anderson and Raney (2018) explored this in an experimental study ( n = 234) and found evidence of the Black criminal stereotype among sports fans. However, more research was needed to further explore this phenomenon. The current study employed a similar experimental design ( n = 603) in an attempt to (1) replicate their 2018 study to examine whether sports fans’ perceptions of criminal athletes have changed over the past several years, especially in light of the Black Lives Matter movement, and (2) determine whether the sport played by an alleged criminal athlete might be linked to judgments regarding race and crime in sports.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our findings indicate that sports fandom still predicts stereotypical judgments.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract states the original found the Black criminal stereotype among sports fans and the replication finds fandom still predicts stereotypical judgments. Stronger alternative predictors do not contradict the stated replicated effect.
